jobs.subject: inside a small neighborhood post office, the woman stands at the counter handing a cardboard parcel with a blank label to a smiling clerk who places it on a scale; a sheet of stamps, three envelopes and two postcards lie on the counter; the man waits behind her holding a paper bag of mandarin oranges. All signs and posters are blank.
